title: Downtown Jive: 1mi->Broadway Fun! Riverside Condo
description:
Welcome to Nashville's Downtown Jive! Dance your way from your condo on the Cumberland River, right into the heart of the Broadway! Community pool (open MDW-Labor Day), fitness center, bars and restaurants just around the corner - you simply can’t beat this location to all of Nashville’s hot spots!

You are only:
A short walk to restaurants & bars
1mi to Broadway Nightlife
1.2mi to Nissan Stadium
1.3mi to Bridgestone Arena
2.2mi to The Gulch
7.7mi to the Airport

Follow us on IG! @peakhost

The space
Nashville’s Premier Downtown 1BR Getaway!

🌟 Pool, Gym, Riverfront Views & Walkable Downtown Location!
Perfect for up to four guests, our stylish condo puts you in the heart of Music City! Enjoy seasonal pool access (MDW–Labor Day), a fitness center, and stunning riverfront views—all just steps from the best of Nashville.

🛏 Cloud-Like Comfort – After a day of honky-tonks and hot chicken, sink into plush sleeping arrangements and a cozy couch. Whether it’s a full night’s rest or a mid-day nap, you’re in for a dreamy recharge.

🍽 Kitchen & Coffee Station – Nashville’s food scene is top-notch, but for those moments when a home-cooked meal or quick bite is in order, our fully stocked kitchen has you covered.

🎶 Your Downtown Jive! – Walk to Broadway, take in the riverfront, or grab a quick rideshare to Nashville’s hottest spots. If you’re looking for a prime downtown stay—this is it!

Book now and make your Nashville getaway unforgettable!

Guest access
The community pool is open from Memorial Day Weekend to Labor Day weekend.

Please be aware that, unfortunately, we do not have control over pool or gym closures and maintenance. It's essential to mention that, as per Airbnb's policy, partial refund requests made during your stay for closures will be regrettably declined.
